QuestInfo.name: [Vampire Season] The King of Darkness
QuestInfo.0: The terribly charming Dark King has come to see you.
QuestInfo.1:
Consuming Vampire Blood will transform you into a Pure Vampire. But you must consume it again within 10 minutes or you will turn into a hideous beast.
Those who can remain a Pure Vampire 100 times will earn a special gift.
Remain a Dark King 100 times: #bDark King Chair#k
Remain a Bloody Queen 100 times: #bBloody Queen Chair#k
Remain a Killer Ace 100 times: #bKiller Ace Chair#k
QuestInfo.2: You have been recognized as a Pure Vampire, and were rewarded by the dark powers that be.
